payload.name: Nova Creative
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create AI images, short videos, and creative variations from a brief or your reference media. Explore visual directions, animate product images, and refine the result in a reusable Nova Creative workflow.

Reopen saved projects, change selected steps, and continue from the same editable workflow. Review available models and estimated usage, confirm generation in the Nova card, follow progress, see previews, and download finished files with a link back to your project.

Requires a connected Nova Creative account. Generation uses the models and usage available to that account.
payload.longDescription:
通过简报或参考素材创建AI图像、短视频和创意变体，探索视觉方向、为产品图片添加动画效果，并在可重复使用的新月创意工作流中优化最终结果。

重新打开已保存项目，修改选定步骤并从同一可编辑工作流继续操作。查看可用模型及预估使用量，在新月卡片中确认生成任务，跟踪进度、预览效果，并通过链接下载完成文件返回项目界面。

需要连接新月创意账户，生成内容将使用该账户对应的模型资源和可用配额。

payload.name: Julius: PowerPoint & Slides
payload.description: AI演示文稿与幻灯片制作工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is an AI presentation maker for creating and editing PowerPoint slide decks. Turn a prompt, outline, notes, Word document, or supported text-based PDF into an editable PPTX presentation with a clear story and consistent slide design.

Create slides from your material: Use text to PowerPoint, document to presentation, and PDF to PPT workflows to turn source content into slide titles, concise talking points, tables, charts, and speaker notes. PDF conversion rebuilds the content as slides rather than reproducing every page exactly.

Make a deck for your audience: Build pitch decks, investor presentations, sales decks, client proposals, business presentations, project updates, training slides, research talks, and educational slideshows. Choose the audience, tone, length, and key message.

Edit and refine presentations: Revise slide copy, reorder sections, adjust layouts and typography, and update supported tables and charts. Work from a new deck or an existing PowerPoint file, with changes handled through format-aware processing.

Apply your presentation style: Use supplied brand colors, fonts, logos, and layout references to create branded slides. Prepare a matching outline, speaker script, or handout when needed.

Save an editable PowerPoint: Get a real .pptx file with editable text and supported slide elements. Continue working with saved presentation files in your Julius library. When requested, create an HTML slideshow or a separate document handout.

Your files stay private unless you ask to publish a completed presentation and receive a public link. PowerPoint requests produce .pptx files; support for an existing deck depends on its features. Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius是用于创建和编辑PowerPoint幻灯片演示文稿的AI制作工具。将提示、大纲、笔记、Word文档或支持的文本型PDF转换为包含清晰叙事和统一幻灯片设计的可编辑PPTX演示文稿。

从您的素材创建幻灯片：通过文本转PowerPoint、文档转演示文稿、PDF转PPT工作流，将源内容转化为幻灯片标题、简洁的演讲要点、表格、图表和演讲者备注。PDF转换会将内容重新构建为幻灯片，而不是逐页复制。

为您的受众制作演示文稿：创建路演演示文稿、投资者汇报、销售演示、客户提案、商务汇报、项目更新、培训幻灯片、研究报告演讲和教育课件。选择受众对象、语气风格、篇幅长度和核心信息。

编辑和优化演示文稿：修改幻灯片内容、调整章节顺序、更改布局排版和字体样式，更新支持的表格和图表。可从新创建的演示文稿或现有PowerPoint文件进行编辑，通过格式感知处理技术实现修改。

应用您的演示文稿风格：使用提供的品牌配色、字体、Logo和版式参考创建品牌化幻灯片。必要时可准备配套的大纲、演讲脚本或纸质手册。

保存可编辑的PowerPoint文件：获取包含可编辑文字和支持的幻灯片元素的真实.pptx文件。可在Julius资料库中继续编辑保存的演示文稿文件。如需可生成HTML幻灯片或独立文档手册。

您的文件保持私密，除非您主动发布完整演示文稿并获取公开链接。PowerPoint请求将生成.pptx文件；对现有演示文稿的支持取决于其具体功能。连接您的Julius账户即可开始使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create editable PowerPoint decks, Turn text and documents into slides, Revise supported PPTX elements, Apply supplied branding, Create presentation handouts, Save presentation files, Publish presentations

payload.name: Portrait Studio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Restyle an attached portrait with backdrop, lighting and framing choices. Preview results inline or compare variations in the portrait workspace. Download images and share a chosen result with chat. AI editing may change facial details; inspect likeness before use. A connected Firemoon account is required.
payload.longDescription:
通过背景、灯光和构图选择重新设计附加人像。
直接预览效果或在人像工作区中比较不同版本。
下载图片并通过聊天分享选定结果。
AI编辑可能会改变面部细节；使用前请检查相似度。
需要连接Firemoon账户。

payload.name: Aaina Product Photos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Aaina is a product photo studio for online sellers. Share one photo of your product (clothing and ethnic wear such as kurtas, sarees and lehengas, jewellery, bags, shoes or accessories) and Aaina shows it worn or held by a realistic studio model, in poses and scenes that suit the product, ready for listings on marketplaces and your own shop.

What you can do in ChatGPT:
- Tag @Aaina, attach a product photo and ask for model photos. The Aaina card reads the product and suggests models, poses and scenes; you can name a model or scene yourself (for example "on Aaina in a white studio").
- Check the choices on the card, then press Make. Photos are made only when you press Make.
- Watch the photos arrive, download them, or open the shoot in Aaina for marketplace sizes.
- Ask to see your photos: the Your photos tab shows the photos you made with Aaina on the website or in ChatGPT, newest first, ready to download.
- Ask which poses or scenes suit your product.

Who it's for: sellers and brands who need consistent catalogue photos without a photoshoot.

Good to know:
- You need an Aaina account (sign in or create one when you connect).
- Studio models are fictional people created for Aaina. Aaina works from product photos only: it doesn't edit photos of real people, and in ChatGPT it offers adult models only.
- Each photo takes about a minute.
payload.longDescription:
Aaina是在线卖家的产品摄影工作室。上传一张产品照片（服装和民族服饰如库塔、纱丽和连衣裙、珠宝、包袋、鞋子或配饰），Aaina会将产品展示在符合产品特点的姿势和场景中的真实工作室模特身上，适用于市场平台和您的店铺销售。

在ChatGPT中可以实现以下操作：
- @Aaina，上传产品照片并请求模特照片。
Aaina卡片会识别产品并推荐模特、姿势和场景；您也可以自行指定模特或场景（例如「Aaina在白色工作室」）。
- 查看卡片上的选项，然后点击生成。
只有在您点击生成时才会制作照片。
- 查看照片结果，下载照片，或在Aaina中打开拍摄以获取市场尺寸。
- 请求查看您的照片：「我的照片」标签页会展示您通过网站或ChatGPT生成的照片，按最新顺序排列，可直接下载。
- 询问哪种姿势或场景适合您的产品。

适用于需要一致目录照片但无需拍摄的卖家和品牌。

注意事项：
- 需要Aaina账户（连接时可登录或注册）。
- 工作室模特是为Aaina创建的虚构人物。
Aaina仅基于产品照片工作：它不会编辑真人照片，在ChatGPT中仅提供成人模特。
- 每张照片大约需要一分钟。

payload.name: Theme Emporium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Theme Emporium helps users browse ready-made visual themes, inspect theme details, and generate a structured, non-persistent UI theme preview from a text brief directly inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Theme Emporium让用户在ChatGPT内部直接浏览现成视觉主题、查看主题详情，并根据文本简报生成结构化非持久化UI主题预览。

payload.name: Gulab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gulab connects your Gulab account to a range of image and video generation models. Describe an image or a short clip and Gulab submits the generation and shows the result in the chat; videos run in the background and appear when ready. You can also save results into Gulab projects, upload reference images, check your credit balance and usage, and open your work on the Gulab canvas at gulab.ai. Generations use credits from your Gulab account.
payload.longDescription: Gulab将您的Gulab账户连接到多种图像和视频生成模型。描述一张图像或一段短片，Gulab会提交生成请求并在聊天中展示结果；视频在后台运行，准备就绪后即可查看。您还可以将结果保存到Gulab项目中，上传参考图片，查看信用余额和使用情况，并在gulab.ai上打开您的作品进行编辑。生成内容将消耗您Gulab账户中的信用额度。

payload.name: Ava Studio for Agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research short-form video references, manage brand media, draft campaign concepts, generate images, video and audio, and edit or export projects in Ava Studio. Sign in with Ava to choose permissions and a monthly credit budget. Actions use existing account credits and return usage information.
payload.longDescription: 在Ava Studio中研究短视频参考素材，管理品牌媒体内容，起草活动概念方案，生成图片/视频/音频素材，并对项目进行编辑或导出。通过Ava登录以选择权限设置和月度信用额度预算。操作将使用现有账户信用额度，并返回使用情况信息。

payload.name: SoeMind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SoeMind creates marketing content for small businesses: short videos, product images, voiceovers and music, organized inside your own brand projects. Connect your SoeMind account to generate content from ChatGPT, check the status of running jobs, browse recent outputs, and get links to finished files. You always see a generation's estimate and approve it before anything runs. Finished content can be published and scheduled to Facebook, Instagram and TikTok from SoeMind. Supports Southeast Asian languages including Burmese and Thai. Requires a SoeMind account.
payload.longDescription: SoeMind为小型企业创建营销内容：短视频、产品图片、配音和音乐，并整理在您自己的品牌项目中。连接您的SoeMind账户，通过ChatGPT生成内容，查看运行中任务的状态，浏览最新输出成果，并获取完成文件的链接。您始终能看到生成内容的预估效果，并在任何内容执行前进行审批。完成的营销内容可直接通过SoeMind发布并安排发布时间至Facebook、Instagram和TikTok。支持包括缅甸语和泰语在内的东南亚语言。需要SoeMind账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate short marketing videos, Generate product and brand images, Generate voiceovers and music, Estimate and approve generations before they run, List projects and recent outputs, Check connected social accounts

payload.name: Formatry
payload.description: 从照片和文案创建广告
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create campaign ad concepts from local product photos and brand copy, edit and preview them, and save verified raster files directly in your Codex workspace. Native OAuth connects your account.
payload.longDescription: 从本地产品照片和品牌文案创建活动广告概念，编辑并预览，将已验证的光栅文件直接保存到您的Codex工作区。原生OAuth可连接您的账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create ad images from your photos and text, Adapt designs for posts, stories and banners, Try new headlines, calls to action and colors, Preview changes to your saved designs

payload.name: PropertyPrompt
payload.description: 从平面图到带家具的3D模型
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PropertyPrompt turns a floor plan into a 3D model of a property that ChatGPT can build, furnish and change for you.

Share a floor plan or describe the rooms, with at least one real measurement. ChatGPT builds the walls, doors, windows and floors to scale in metres, then furnishes the rooms with real products, modelled from their published dimensions with a link to the retailer's page. A live viewer in the chat shows each change as it is made, and ChatGPT can render a view to check how a room looks.

Use it to plan a move, try furniture before you buy it, check whether a sofa fits or compare layouts. Every change is made against the property's current version and kept in its history, so you can ask ChatGPT to undo it.

For renters and property owners planning a space, and for interior designers and estate agents who model properties for clients.

You sign in with a PropertyPrompt account, and the app reaches only that account's properties. Properties are private. Only you can make one public, on propertyprom.pt; ChatGPT can never do it. Open a property on propertyprom.pt to walk through it in the browser or in VR.

Limitations: a model is only as accurate as the plans and measurements it is built from, and is not architectural or engineering advice. Product names, prices and links come from ChatGPT's research and can be out of date; the retailer's own page is what counts. PropertyPrompt does not sell products or take payments, and is not affiliated with the retailers shown. Accounts have a property limit and a fair use policy.
payload.longDescription:
PropertyPrompt能将平面图转化为ChatGPT可构建、布置并修改的3D房产模型。

上传平面图或描述房间信息，并提供至少一个实际尺寸。
ChatGPT会按米为单位精确构建墙体、门、窗和地板，然后通过链接跳转至零售商页面，用真实产品布置房间。
聊天中的实时查看器可展示每次修改效果，ChatGPT还能渲染视角检查房间效果。

可用于规划搬迁、购买前试摆家具、确认沙发尺寸或对比布局。
每次修改都基于房产当前版本并记录历史，您可要求ChatGPT撤销操作。

适用于计划空间的租户/房产所有者，以及为客户提供房产模型的室内设计师和房产经纪人。

您需使用PropertyPrompt账户登录，应用仅访问该账户的房产。
房产信息为私有内容。
只有您可将房产设为公开，地址为propertyprom.pt；ChatGPT无法自行公开。
在propertyprom.pt打开房产可在浏览器或VR中浏览。

限制说明：模型准确性取决于原始平面图和尺寸数据，不构成建筑或工程建议。
产品名称、价格和链接来自ChatGPT的调研可能已过时；以零售商页面信息为准。
PropertyPrompt不销售产品或处理支付，且与展示零售商无关联。
账户设有房产数量限制和合理使用政策。

payload.name: Adly
payload.description: 创建并发布社交媒体内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adly is an AI marketing platform for small businesses and agencies. Tell ChatGPT what you want to promote and Adly designs the post, carousel, video or ad on your brand (your logo, colors, fonts and tone), writes the copy in Arabic or English, and publishes or schedules it to your Facebook Page, Instagram, LinkedIn profile and X account.

What you can do:
- Create single-post designs, tip carousels, product-photo ads, UGC-style and scene-based videos.
- Write and edit ad copy, then approve it in chat.
- Check what is ready, preview it, and ask for changes.
- Publish now or schedule for later, list upcoming posts and cancel one.
- Open the Adly content board from the sidebar to see your latest content and everything that is scheduled.

Limits to know: creating content counts toward your Adly usage limit. You need an Adly account to connect. Social accounts are connected once on getadly.com. Posts to X have no links, and X posting is not included in every Adly account. TikTok publishing is coming soon.
payload.longDescription:
Adly是面向小型企业和代理商的AI营销平台。告诉ChatGPT您想推广的内容，Adly将根据您的品牌（包括logo、颜色、字体和语气）设计帖子、轮播图、视频或广告，用阿拉伯语或英语撰写文案，并发布或预约发布到您的Facebook页面、Instagram、LinkedIn个人资料和X账号。

您可以：
- 创建单条帖子设计、小贴士轮播图、产品图片广告、用户生成内容风格及场景类视频。
- 撰写并编辑广告文案，通过聊天窗口进行审批。
- 查看待处理内容，预览后提出修改要求。
- 立即发布或预约后续发布，查看待发内容并取消某条帖子。
- 从侧边栏打开Adly内容看板，查看最新内容及所有预约内容。

需注意的限制：创建内容会消耗您的Adly使用配额。您需要Adly账户才能连接。社交账号需在getadly.com一次性连接。发往X平台的内容不含链接，X平台发帖功能并非所有Adly账户均支持。TikTok发布功能即将上线。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create designs, Create videos, Write ad copy, Publish posts, Schedule posts, Content board

payload.name: Etch Express
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Etch Express helps trophy, award, and engraving shops prepare production designs. Create and edit engraving jobs, recipient tables, plate layouts, and bed layouts; reuse saved templates; upload artwork and source documents; validate saved geometry; and export PDF or SVG ZIP files. Manage store inventory, view analytics, and update store and organization settings according to your account permissions.
payload.longDescription: Etch Express帮助奖杯、奖项和雕刻店准备生产设计。创建和编辑雕刻任务、收件人表格、板布局和床布局；复用已保存的模板；上传艺术作品和源文件；验证保存的几何图形；导出PDF或SVG压缩文件。根据账户权限管理店铺库存、查看分析数据，并更新店铺和组织设置。

payload.name: Designelier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create coherent sets of 1–6 stylized icons or isolated spot illustrations from named subjects, a shared style and a color palette. Review the asset plan before generation, preview the results in chat, and download a ZIP with transparent full-canvas and cropped WebP plus self-contained SVG files. SVG files contain embedded raster artwork, not editable vector paths. You can also create website-matched illustration packs from a public URL. Requires a Designelier account. Does not edit existing images, trace vectors, create fonts or build websites.
payload.longDescription: 从命名主题、统一风格和配色方案中生成1-6个风格化图标的连贯系列，或单独的插图。生成前审查资产计划，在聊天中预览结果，并下载包含透明背景全画布和裁剪后的WebP格式文件，以及自包含SVG文件的ZIP包。SVG文件包含嵌入式位图艺术，而非可编辑矢量路径。您也可以通过公共URL创建匹配网站的插图套装。需要Designelier账户。不支持编辑现有图片、矢量追踪、创建字体或构建网站。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate icon sets, Generate spot illustrations, Preview assets, Download SVG and WebP

payload.name: RoomLab.app
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RoomLab.app helps homeowners, interior designers, and real estate professionals visualize changes to rooms and properties using images they provide. Use Virtual Staging to furnish an empty room, Change Style to restyle a furnished room, Declutter Room to remove clutter, or Empty Room to remove furniture. Use Replace Furniture or Replace Material with a reference image, and Wall Colors to compare nine paint colors. Create an Interior Architectural Render or Exterior Architectural Render from a design image. Use Video Walkthrough to animate one photo, Video Transition to animate between two images, or House Tour to combine three to six room images. You can also make an existing RoomLab.app result 4K. Connect an existing RoomLab.app account and provide the images needed for your request. Available actions depend on your connected account's access. Results are visualizations, not construction plans or measurements.
payload.longDescription: RoomLab.app帮助房主、室内设计师和房地产专业人士通过他们提供的图片可视化房间和房产的改动。使用虚拟布置功能为闲置房间布置家具，使用更改风格功能重塑已布置房间的风格，使用清理房间功能去除杂物，或使用空房间功能移除家具。通过参考图片使用替换家具或替换材质功能，并使用墙色功能对比九种油漆颜色。从设计图片创建室内建筑渲染或室外建筑渲染。使用视频漫游功能对单张照片进行动画处理，使用视频过渡功能对两张图片进行动画处理，或使用房屋漫游功能将三到六张房间图片组合在一起。您还可以将现有的RoomLab.app结果制作成4K画质。连接现有的RoomLab.app账户并提供您需求所需的图片。可用操作取决于您连接账户的权限。结果为可视化效果，而非施工图纸或测量数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Virtual Staging, Declutter Room, Replace Material, Wall Colors, Video Walkthrough, Video Transition, House Tour

payload.name: Print Ready
payload.description: 设计实用的可打印部件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn an idea into a custom 3D-printable design with just a few measurements or photos. Make replacement parts, organizers, mounts, holders, adapters, cases, tools and personalized gifts.  Or, design complicated projects simply via chat!
Preview your design in 3D and download an STL file for your printer right in ChatGPT.  Find examples and instructions at https://printreadyparts.com.
payload.longDescription: 只需几个测量值或照片，即可将创意转化为定制的3D可打印设计。制作替换零件、收纳盒、支架、固定器、适配器、外壳、工具和个性化礼品。或通过聊天简单设计复杂项目！在ChatGPT中预览您的3D设计，并直接下载适用于您打印机的STL文件。在https://printreadyparts.com上查找示例和说明。

payload.name: YouArt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use YouArt to build, edit, run, and review AI creative workflows in your connected workspace. Import source media, compose image, video, and audio nodes, and receive generated results directly in the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 通过YouArt在连接的工作空间中创建、编辑、执行和审核AI创意工作流。导入源媒体，组合图像、视频和音频节点，并直接在对话中接收生成的结果。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create AI media workflows, Edit YouArt projects, Run generation workflows

payload.name: OpenClip
payload.description: 查找并添加视频片段字幕
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the moments worth sharing in interviews, podcasts, and webinars. OpenClip turns a supported video link into ranked clip previews. Review the moments, choose a caption style, and export the clips you select.

For an existing short video, add captions to an upload up to three minutes long. Find previous videos and read time-coded transcripts to locate a quote or revisit a moment.

Connect your OpenClip account to work with videos in your current team. New clipping jobs require eligible account access and processing credits; Quick Captions has separate export limits. Processing runs in the background; check its status to see when previews or exports are ready.
payload.longDescription:
在采访、播客和网络研讨会中找到值得分享的精彩时刻。
OpenClip可将受支持的视频链接转换为排名靠前的片段预览。
浏览精彩片段，选择字幕样式，并导出您选中的视频片段。

为现有短视频添加字幕，支持上传时长不超过三分钟的视频。

payload.name: Rawnd
payload.description: 在聊天中打开RAW格式照片
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rawnd opens camera RAW photos inside the conversation. ChatGPT reads JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF; a NEF, CR3, ARW or RAF file shows it nothing. Rawnd adds a panel where you drop the RAW file. The file is read on your device, inside the panel, and never uploaded: not to Rawnd, not to OpenAI.

What it does
- Shows the JPEG the camera stored inside the RAW file, in under a second, with the shooting data: camera, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO and focal length.
- Lets you keep that JPEG (right-click the preview, "Save image as…") or show it to ChatGPT with one click, stripped of its metadata, so you can talk about the photo.
- Offers eight hand-written looks: Dark film, Warm film, High-contrast B&W, Cool & muted, Golden hour, Matte, Crisp & vivid and Teal & orange. ChatGPT picks the one that matches what you describe, can adjust it within narrow bounds ("a bit less warm"), and shows a card that opens it in Rawnd's editor, in the browser.

Who it is for
Photographers with RAW files from Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm, Panasonic, Olympus, Pentax, Samsung, Leica, Phase One and other cameras, who want to see a RAW file, get a JPEG out of it or pick a look for it, without installing anything. Sixteen formats: CR2, CR3, CRW, NEF, NRW, ARW, SRF, SR2, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, PEF, SRW, IIQ and RAW.

Limits
- The panel shows the camera's own rendering, at the size the camera stored: full size on most Nikon and Canon bodies, 1920 × 1280 on Fujifilm. Developing the RAW itself (exposure, white balance) happens in Rawnd's editor.
- Camera RAW files only: it does not open JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
- A look opens in the editor; it is not applied inside the conversation.
- One file at a time.

Privacy
Rawnd's server receives only the tool arguments, a look's name and slider values, and counts one row per call: the tool and the assistant. No account, no sign-in, no photo.
payload.longDescription:
Rawnd 可在对话中打开相机 RAW 格式照片。
ChatGPT 可以读取 JPEG、PNG、WebP 和 GIF 格式；但遇到 NEF、CR3、ARW 或 RAF 文件时则无法处理。
Rawnd 添加了一个文件面板用于放置 RAW 文件。
文件在您的设备上读取，位于面板内，且永远不会上传：既不会上传至 Rawnd，也不会上传至 OpenAI。

功能说明
- 在一秒内显示 RAW 文件中相机存储的 JPEG 图像，并附带拍摄数据：相机型号、镜头、快门速度、光圈、ISO 和焦距。
- 允许您保存该 JPEG 图像（右键预览图，选择「另存为」）或通过单击将图像发送给 ChatGPT，图像会自动去除元数据，方便您讨论照片内容。
- 提供八种手写风格：暗调胶片、暖调胶片、高对比度黑白、冷调柔和、黄金时刻、哑光、鲜明生动和青橙色调。
ChatGPT 会根据您描述的内容选择匹配的风格，可在狭窄范围内调整（「稍微冷一点」），并显示一张可点击的卡片，直接在浏览器中打开 Rawnd 编辑器。

适用人群
适用于使用尼康、佳能、索尼、富士、松下、奥林巴斯、宾得、三星、徕卡、Phase One 等相机拍摄 RAW 格式文件的摄影师，无需安装任何软件即可查看 RAW 文件、导出 JPEG 或为照片选择风格。
支持十六种格式：CR2、CR3、CRW、NEF、NRW、ARW、SRF、SR2、RAF、DNG、RW2、ORF、PEF、SRW、IIQ 和 RAW。

使用限制
- 面板仅显示相机原生渲染效果，尺寸为相机存储的原始尺寸：大多数尼康和佳能设备为全尺寸，富士设备为 1920 × 1280。
RAW 文件的处理（曝光、白平衡）需在 Rawnd 编辑器中完成。
- 仅支持相机 RAW 格式文件：不支持 JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC 格式。
- 风格效果仅在编辑器中打开，不会直接应用在对话中。
- 每次仅处理一个文件。

隐私政策
Rawnd 服务器仅接收工具参数、风格名称和滑块值，并按每次调用统计一行：工具和助手各占一行。
无需账户、无需登录、不存储任何照片。

payload.longDescription: 通过 Railway App 和 Railway Skills，在 ChatGPT 中使用 Railway。创建并上线应用，了解运行表现，管理项目，并排查问题。

payload.name: Floot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and host full-stack apps using your own ChatGPT subscription. No AI build credits required. Floot MCP Server exposes the entire platform as native ChatGPT tool calls: create a project, write code, provision a database, enable auth, manage file storage, and deploy, all from a single conversation. Your ChatGPT subscription does the building. Floot handles the infrastructure. One conversation in, one working, hosted app out.
payload.longDescription: 使用你自己的 ChatGPT 订阅构建和托管全栈应用。无需 AI 构建额度。Floot MCP Server 将整个平台开放为 ChatGPT 原生工具调用：在单次对话中创建项目、编写代码、配置数据库、启用身份验证、管理文件存储并部署。你的 ChatGPT 订阅负责构建，Floot 负责基础设施。输入一次对话，产出一个可运行、已托管的应用。

payload.name: AppDeploy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AppDeploy helps users build and publish web apps from ChatGPT, monitor deployment and QA results, manage versions and source snapshots, add backend secrets, and configure custom domains.
payload.longDescription: AppDeploy 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 构建和发布网页应用，监控部署与 QA 结果，管理版本和源代码快照，添加后端密钥，并配置自定义域名。

payload.name: Stack Overflow For Agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stack Overflow For Agents provides free, trusted, production-tested knowledge, so your agents spend less time and fewer tokens rediscovering answers.  Agents can view, reply to, upvote, and verify posts created by other agents.  Is your agent stuck on a technical problem?  It can ask a question on Stack Overflow For Agents and see if other agents can solve the problem.
payload.longDescription: Stack Overflow For Agents 提供免费、可信且经生产环境验证的知识，帮助智能体减少重复寻找答案所花的时间和 token。智能体可以查看、回复、点赞并验证其他智能体创建的帖子。如果智能体遇到技术问题，可以在 Stack Overflow For Agents 上提问，看看其他智能体能否解决。

payload.name: ClickHouse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClickHouse plugin helps users inspect ClickHouse Cloud organizations, services, databases, tables, backups, ClickPipes, billing costs, and Managed Postgres diagnostics, and run read-only SQL queries.
payload.longDescription: ClickHouse 插件帮助用户查看 ClickHouse Cloud 组织、服务、数据库、表、备份、ClickPipes、账单费用和 Managed Postgres 诊断信息，并运行只读 SQL 查询。

payload.name: Primitive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Primitive Email lets users create an agent-ready email address, read and search inbound mail, send new messages, reply in threads, manage domains and webhooks, inspect delivery history, and troubleshoot email routing from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Primitive Email可让用户创建适用于AI代理的电子邮件地址，查阅并搜索传入邮件，发送新消息，在对话中回复，管理域名和Webhook，检查交付历史，并通过ChatGPT排查电子邮件路由问题。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read email, Search email, Send email, Reply to email

payload.name: GSC Wizard
payload.description: 分析 Google 搜索数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.
payload.longDescription: GSC Wizard 将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Google Search Console 资源，让你用日常语言分析 SEO 表现。你可以索要表现汇总、热门查询和页面、两个时期之间的排名变化、内容衰退、关键词内耗、点击率与排名曲线或完整 SEO 报告，并获得完整答案。所有分析都在服务器端基于数据仓库计算，避免向模型传入数千行原始数据，让结果快速、准确且节省 token。你还可以列出并查看资源、运行 Google 的网址检查、追踪索引收录、管理主题集群和内容分组，并向 IndexNow 提交 URL。它还能就你已关联的 Google Analytics 4 资源提供报告，包括流量概览、维度拆分、电商、关键事件（转化）、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 等 AI 助手引荐的流量，以及合并 Search Console 与 GA4 数据的着陆页视图。汇总工具直接在 ChatGPT 中呈现交互式卡片和表格。所有访问均通过 Google 登录限定在你自己的账户范围内。

payload.name: Lovable
payload.description: 通过聊天构建全栈应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language. Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build. Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
payload.longDescription: Lovable 根据自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用。描述一个应用，Lovable 就会创建项目、编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回实时预览，让你看到构建过程。通过后续消息可以进一步完善应用；你还可以查看生成的代码和差异，添加 PostgreSQL 数据库及第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用发布到公开 URL。

payload.name: TinyFish
payload.description: 查找并完成 Web 任务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TinyFish helps ChatGPT answer web questions and complete user-directed browser workflows. It can search the web, read specific pages, and run a live browser session for tasks that require interaction, such as navigating a site, clicking, filling forms, checking page state, or working inside a web app. Use it for specific requested tasks; it is not for broad crawling, bulk URL processing, or unspecified third-party access.
payload.longDescription: TinyFish 帮助 ChatGPT 回答网络问题，并完成由用户指定的浏览器工作流。它可以搜索网络、读取特定页面，并为需要交互的任务运行实时浏览器会话，例如浏览网站、点击、填写表单、检查页面状态或在 Web 应用中操作。请将其用于具体请求的任务；它不适用于广泛爬取、批量处理 URL 或未经明确指定的第三方访问。

payload.name: Netlify
payload.description: 在 Netlify 上构建和部署
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and deploy on Netlify
payload.longDescription: 在 Netlify 上构建和部署

payload.name: Neon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Neon lets users inspect and manage Neon projects, branches, computes, Postgres databases, authentication, data APIs, functions, storage, logs, and database changes through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 查看并管理 Neon 项目、分支、计算资源、Postgres 数据库、身份验证、数据 API、函数、存储、日志和数据库变更。

payload.name: Resend
payload.description: 面向开发者的电子邮件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Resend helps users send transactional email, inspect delivery and request logs, manage audiences, domains, templates, broadcasts, automations, webhooks, API keys, and OAuth grants from ChatGPT using their own Resend credentials.
payload.longDescription: Resend 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用自己的 Resend 凭据发送事务性电子邮件、查看投递和请求日志，并管理受众、域名、模板、群发邮件、自动化流程、webhook、API 密钥和 OAuth 授权。

payload.name: Base44
payload.description: 用 AI 构建应用和网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build fully functional apps and websites with AI in minutes. No code, just your words.
Base44 turns a single sentence into a real product. Describe what you want and watch it get built in minutes. Edit, design, and add features from chat, connect tools in one click, add smart agents, schedule tasks on autopilot, and track analytics
If you can describe it, you can build it with Base44.
payload.longDescription:
几分钟内用 AI 构建功能完整的应用和网站。无需代码，只需用语言描述。
Base44 将一句话转为真实产品。描述你的需求，看着它在几分钟内完成构建。在聊天中编辑、设计和添加功能，一键连接工具，添加智能体，自动安排任务，并跟踪分析数据。
只要能描述，就能用 Base44 构建。

payload.name: Hatchable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hatchable lets you host full-stack web applications you build, deploy, and manage via MCP tools..  A marketing site, an internal tool, a family recipe tracker — Hatchable provisions a database, writes your files, deploys the backend functions, and hands back a live URL.  Just prompt "build ... on hatchable".   Personal projects are free forever; publish to the open web or use a custom domain on a paid plan.
payload.longDescription: Hatchable 让你通过 MCP 工具托管、部署和管理构建的全栈 Web 应用。无论是营销网站、内部工具还是家庭食谱追踪器，Hatchable 都会配置数据库、写入文件、部署后端函数并返回在线网址。只需提示“在 hatchable 上构建……”。个人项目永久免费；发布到开放网络或使用自定义域名需付费方案。

payload.name: Datadog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Datadog MCP Server helps users investigate observability data, inspect dashboards and notebooks, load Datadog skill guidance, search Datadog entities, review change stories, and visualize Datadog metrics, logs, traces, RUM events, incidents, hosts, monitors, and events through ChatGPT for this scoped connection.
payload.longDescription: Datadog MCP Server 帮助用户调查可观测性数据、检查仪表板和笔记本、加载 Datadog 技能指南、搜索 Datadog 实体、查看变更故事，并通过 ChatGPT 可视化本次限定连接中的 Datadog 指标、日志、跟踪、RUM 事件、事故、主机、监视器和事件。

payload.name: WordPress.com
payload.description: 用 WordPress 构建并发布
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Describe what you need and WordPress builds it: a portfolio, a restaurant menu, a blog, an online store. Tell WordPress about your business, your audience, what pages you need. It plans the site, writes the content, picks a design, and launches it on WordPress.com. 

Already have a WordPress.com site? Connect it to publish and schedule posts, check your traffic, moderate comments, manage plugins, and update settings. 70+ abilities across your full site. 

WordPress.com's plugin connects ChatGPT or Codex directly to WordPress.com, so you can build a new site or manage an existing one — all through conversation.

If you are running locally in Codex, you can also connect to WordPress Studio for local site builds, theme and plugin development, site edits and site administration.
payload.longDescription:
描述你的需求，WordPress 就会为你创建网站：作品集、餐厅菜单、博客或网店。告诉 WordPress 你的业务、受众和所需页面。它会规划网站、撰写内容、挑选设计，并在 WordPress.com 上发布。

已经拥有 WordPress.com 网站？连接后即可发布和安排文章、查看流量、审核评论、管理插件并更新设置。覆盖整个网站的 70 多项功能。

WordPress.com 插件可将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 直接连接到 WordPress.com，让你通过对话创建新网站或管理现有网站。

如果你在 Codex 中本地运行，也可以连接 WordPress Studio，用于本地建站、主题和插件开发、网站编辑及站点管理。

payload.name: SentinelX
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux, macOS, or Windows host, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage services (systemd, launchd, or Windows services), read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and your OS's file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple hosts and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit config files, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.
payload.longDescription:
SentinelX 让你无需 SSH 即可在 ChatGPT 中管理 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 服务器。在任意 Linux、macOS 或 Windows 主机上安装轻量级开源代理，ChatGPT 就能运行检查命令、管理服务（systemd、launchd 或 Windows 服务）、读取/搜索/编辑文件、运行脚本、上传文件，并调用 Cloudflare DNS、Resend 和 Telegram 等集成。

每项操作都受你控制的主机级允许列表约束。代理只会运行你明确声明安全的命令和服务，在代理边界拒绝策略之外的操作，同时仍受操作系统文件权限约束。你可以连接多台主机，并按任意方式为其命名。

常见用途包括：检查运行时间和磁盘空间、重启服务、查看日志末尾、编辑配置文件、运行快捷脚本、管理 DNS 记录和发送通知。该代理在 GitHub 开源（github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core）。身份验证使用 OAuth 2.0（含 PKCE）和动态客户端注册，并按用户授权范围隔离。

payload.name: Context7
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LLMs rely on outdated or generic information about the libraries you use. You get outdated code examples based on year-old training data and hallucinated APIs that don't even exist.

Context7 fetches up-to-date code examples and documentation right into your LLM's context. No tab-switching, no hallucinated APIs that don't exist, no outdated code generation.
payload.longDescription:
LLM 依赖的库信息往往过时或过于笼统。你可能会得到基于一年前训练数据的过时代码示例，以及根本不存在的虚构 API。

Context7 会将最新代码示例和文档直接引入 LLM 的上下文。无需切换标签页，不再遇到虚构 API，也不会生成过时代码。

payload.name: GitLab (Beta)
payload.description: 分诊 GitLab MR 和 CI/CD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your GitLab workflow into ChatGPT.

Explore projects and repositories, manage issues, review merge requests, address feedback,
and investigate failing CI/CD checks. When you're ready, make code changes and open a
draft merge request.
payload.longDescription:
将 GitLab 工作流带入 ChatGPT：浏览项目和仓库、管理

issue、审查合并请求、处理反馈、调查失败的 CI/CD 检查，并在准备好后修改代码和创建草稿合并请求。

payload.name: Tavily
payload.description: 面向 AI 的网络搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Web Infrastructure Layer for AI Agents. A purpose-built web API for real-time search, scraping, crawling, and structured data retrieval. AI-native enterprises trust Tavily for data enrichment, research, RAG pipelines, and autonomous AI systems-ensuring fresh, accurate, and scalable intelligence.
payload.longDescription: AI 智能体的网络基础设施层。专为实时搜索、抓取网页、爬取网站和结构化数据检索打造的 Web API。以 AI 为核心的企业信任 Tavily，可用于数据增强、研究、RAG 流程和自主 AI 系统，帮助确保信息新鲜、准确且可扩展。

payload.name: Replit
payload.description: 将创意变为真正可用的应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Turn your ideas into real apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Replit turns your ideas into real, running web apps and websites, with no coding or setup required. Describe what you want in plain language and Replit's AI Agent builds a working app for you (frontend, backend, database, and auth as needed), then hosts it so you can use and share it right away. Keep the conversation going to refine and extend your app, ask how a feature works, or check whether it's ready to deploy. It's great for rapid prototyping, quick experiments, internal tools, and turning ideas into something you can actually run as fast as you can describe them.
payload.longDescription: Replit 可将你的创意转变为真正运行的网站和 Web 应用，无需编码或设置。只需用日常语言描述需求，Replit 的 AI Agent 就会构建可运行的应用（按需包含前端、后端、数据库和身份验证），随后托管应用，让你立即使用和分享。你可以继续对话来完善和扩展应用、询问某项功能的工作方式，或确认应用是否已准备好部署。它非常适合快速原型、快速实验、内部工具，以及将想法迅速变成真正可运行的产品。

payload.name: Convex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Convex helps users build and scale JavaScript and TypeScript apps with a reactive, type-safe backend. The app gives ChatGPT concrete Convex setup guidance for new projects, existing frontend integrations, production scaling questions, and the bundled Convex quickstart runbook so agents follow the current deployment, auth, and component patterns instead of hand-rolling from stale memory.
payload.longDescription: Convex 帮助用户使用 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 构建并扩展应用，提供响应式、类型安全的后端。该应用可为 ChatGPT 提供新项目设置、现有前端集成、生产环境扩展问题以及内置 Convex 快速入门操作手册方面的具体指导，让智能体遵循当前的部署、身份验证和组件模式，而不是依赖过时记忆自行拼凑。

payload.name: Namecheap
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Namecheap’s enables domain name availability checking and pricing lookup for single or multiple domains. Users can search for specific domains, request alternative suggestions when domains are unavailable, and compare pricing across different TLDs. The server returns real-time availability status and accurate pricing from Namecheap's Platform. Best used for domain discovery, bulk domain checks, and helping users find available alternatives.
payload.longDescription: Namecheap 支持查询单个或多个域名是否可用及其价格。用户可以搜索特定域名，在域名不可用时请求替代建议，并比较不同顶级域名的价格。服务器会从 Namecheap 平台返回实时可用状态和准确价格。适合发现域名、批量检查域名，以及帮助用户寻找可用替代选项。
